question: Show the top customers by total net sales amount in March 2026.
sql:
SELECT c.CustomerName, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(sd.NetAmount, 0)), 2) AS total_net_amount
FROM SalesDocument sd
JOIN Customer c ON sd.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
WHERE IFNULL(sd.IsCanceled, 0) = 0
AND sd.DocumentDate >= '2026-03-01' AND sd.DocumentDate < '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.CustomerName
ORDER BY total_net_amount DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: Top general-ledger accounts by credit in March 2026.
sql:
SELECT
  l.AccountCode,
  l.AccountName,
  ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(a.CreditAmount, 0)), 2) AS total_credit
FROM AccountingPosting a
JOIN LedgerAccount l ON a.LedgerAccountId = l.LedgerAccountId
JOIN SalesDocument d ON a.SalesDocumentId = d.SalesDocumentId
WHERE d.DocumentDate >= '2026-03-01' AND d.DocumentDate < '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY l.LedgerAccountId, l.AccountCode, l.AccountName
ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(a.CreditAmount, 0)) DESC, l.AccountCode ASC
LIMIT 10
